title: The Sick Cow
text:
Long ago, a poor farmer lived near a big mountain. He had one cow. One day, the cow was sick.

The farmer was very sad. A little bird came and said, 'Give the cow fresh grass.' The farmer did it, and the cow got better.

questions.text: What did the bird tell the farmer?
options: Take the cow to the sea
Let the cow sleep all day

questions.text: How did the farmer probably feel when the cow was sick?
Why did the cow get better?
options: The farmer gave it fresh grass

vocabulary.definition: a person who grows crops or keeps animals on a farm
a green plant that cows and other animals eat
an animal with feathers and wings that can usually fly

paragraph_translations: Dawno temu biedny rolnik mieszkał blisko dużej góry. Miał jedną krowę. Pewnego dnia krowa była chora.
Rolnik był bardzo smutny. Mały ptak przyleciał i powiedział: «Daj krowie świeżą trawę». Rolnik tak zrobił i krowa poczuła się lepiej.
